title: Why Gold Is Going Up Is Now A Bitcoin Story
evidence: UUP 일봉 255개 · GLD-UUP 일간수익률 피어슨 상관 -0.39 (n=254, 자체 계산)
description:
https://www.signumhq.com - FREE market intel.

Gold is up 34.8% over the past year and 12.8% in the past month. But it still closed 16.4% below its January 29 high of $495.90. So what changed this summer?

We ran the numbers ourselves. Gold's 42-day correlation with bitcoin is 0.62 right now. The one-year median is 0.26, and 0.62 sits in the 94th percentile of all 213 windows we measured. It has climbed every single month since spring.

Two factors, the dollar and bitcoin, explained 19% of gold's daily moves across the year. Over the last six weeks they explain 50%.

Gold has stopped trading like a fear hedge and started trading like a currency hedge.

Data: GLD, IBIT and UUP daily closes, Aug 15 2025 to Aug 20 2026. All correlations computed by us.
Educational only. Not investment advice.
